paite: Elisha in, "TOUPA thu na za un. TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Zingchiang hiai hun ding vel in Samaria kulh kongpi bul ah tangbuang nel tehna khat shekel khat in akhawng ding ua, barli buh tehna nih shekel khat in," chi in agen hi.
heading: Elisha Thugenkholhna

paite: Heutu khat kumpipa'n akhut angaknapa'n Pathian mipa adawng hi. "Ngai in, TOUPA'N van ah tohlette bawl leh leng hiai bang ahi thei mahmah dia hia?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Ngai in, na mit in na mu dia, himahleh na ne kei ding," achi hi.
Huai lai in kulh lutna kongpi bul ah phak li a-om uhi. Amau, "Bangziak a sih ngak lel a tu nilouh i hi ua?
heading: Siria Sepaihte Apaikhia Uh

paite: Khopi sung ah lut ni, chi leng, khopi sung kial a, huai a va si mai ding hang a; hiai ah tu nilouh lehang lah si thouthou ding hang a; huaiziak in tu in pai ni in Siria sepaihte kiang ah i va lut peuhmah ding uh. Ahon na hinghawi uh leh i hing dia; ahon na thah uleh si i himai ke," chi in akihou uhi,
Huchi in Siriate giahphual a hoh ding in khomui in akuan uhi. Siriate giahphual tuah masak ava tun un, ngai in, kuamah ana om kei uhi.

TOUPA'N Siria sepaihte kangtalaite husa, sakolte husa leh sepaih tampi husa ana zasak hi. Huchi in "Ngai un, Israel kumpipa'n Hit kumpipate leh Aigupta kumpipate ei hong dou dia guai ei ve,” chi in akihou uhi.
Huchi in athou ua, khomui in ataikekta uh. Apuaninte uh, asakolte uh, asabiltungte uh leh agiahphual uh a-om ngeingei in ataisan ua, ataikekta uhi.

Huai mi phakte giahphual tuah masak ava tun un puanin khat ah alut ua, ne in adawn uh. Dangkasik, dangka-eng leh puansilhte ala ua, asel ua; anungkik nawn ua, puanin dang ah alut nawn ua, huai leng ala ua, asel uhi.

"Aden chiang in, i hihdik het kei. Tuni tanchin kipahhuai tun ni ahi a, ei i daih dide ua; khovak i ngak uleh gawtna i tuak ding uh. Huaiziak in kisa ni, kumpipa inkote i va hilh ding uh," chỉ in akihou uhi.

Huchi in khopi kongkhak vengmi ava sam ua, "Siriate giahphual ah ka va hoh ua, ngai in, kuamah ana om kei ua, mihing husa himhim leng a-om kei, sakolte leh sabiltungte kia ana kikhih a, puaninte leng a-om ngeingei in ana om uh," chi in ahilh uhi.
Kongkhak veng mite asam a; amau kumpipa insung a mite ava hilh uh.

Zan in kumpipa athou a, asikhate kiang ah, "Siriate hon bawldan ka hon hilh ding. I gilkialdan uh athei uh. Huaiziak in khopi a pan ahong pawt uleh ahing in i na man ding ua, khosung ah i lut ding uh, chi in gamlak a kibu dia agiahphual uh pawtkhiaksan ahi uh," achi hi.

Asikhate lak a khat in adawng a, "Khopi a omsun sakol nga va pisak inla, ngai in, Israel mipi adam lai tengteng Israel mipite si bang a sehte ahi himhim uhi; huchi in amaute sawl in enkhe ni," achi hi.
Huchi in kangtalai kai sakol nih api ua; kumpipa'n, "Va en dih ua," chi in Siria sepaihte delh ding in asawl hi.
Jordan lui pha in ava delh ua; ngai in, Siriate'n akin ziak ua apaih uh puansilhte leh vante, lamtawn in a-om zelzul hi. Huchi in amisawlte ahong kik nawn ua, kumpipa ahong hilh uhi.
Huchi in mipi apawtkhia ua, Siriate giahphual ava lok uhi. Huchi in TOUPA thu bang ngei in tangbuang nel tehna khat shekel khat in akhong ua, barli buh tehna nih shekel khat mah in.
Kumpipa'n sepaih heutu, akhut angaknapa kulh kongpi vengmi in asep hi. Mipite'n akulh kongpi bul ah achil uhi, Pathian mipa'n akiang a kumpipa ahong paisuk lai a, ana gen bang in asita hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, Pathian mipa'n kumpipa kiang a, Zingchiang hichih hun ding vel in Samaria kulh kongpi bul ah, "Barli buh tehna nih shekel khat in akhong ding ua, tangbuang nel tehna khat shekel khat mah in," achih a;

sepaih heutu in Pathian mipa adawng a, "Ngai in, TOUPA'N van ah tohlette bawlleh leng, huchibang ahi thei dia hia?" achih a, ama'n, "Ngai in, na mit in na mu ngei dia, himahleh na ne kei ding," achih bang in;
huchibang in atung ah ahong tungta hi; mipi'n kulh kongpi bul a achil ziak un asita hi.
